name: Left Click Player 2
description: Lets you bind Player 2's jump to the left mouse button in two-player mode.

exclusive.name: Left click ONLY controls Player 2
exclusive.description: When enabled, left clicking no longer makes Player 1 jump, so the left mouse button is dedicated to Player 2. When disabled, left click makes both players jump.

debug-logs.name: Debug logs
debug-logs.description: Logs every handled click to the Geode log. Useful for troubleshooting; leave off normally.
